profiles.label: Mac built-in microphone
profiles.notes: Good for VAD/ASR and local testing; not enough for reliable cocktail-party DOA.

profiles.label: Windows WASAPI default microphone
profiles.notes: Use for single-user VAD/ASR smoke tests.

profiles.label: Sipeed 6+1 Mic Array USB
profiles.notes: Official MA-USB8 docs expose 8ch S16_LE 48kHz: CH0-CH5 raw outer ring PCM, CH6 board beam/average output, CH7 raw/reference candidate. Verify physical channel order and CH7 role before production; geometry assumes 6 outer microphones on a 35 mm ring.

profiles.label: Reachy Mini native audio
profiles.notes: Use the official media stack when running on the robot; default AEC and DOA are available in the platform stack.
